title: The Origins of Life
dek: Three stories about how chemistry became biology — a molecule that copies, a membrane that holds, a fire that runs. Then a fourth that asks whether any of them can be the first chapter.

stories.title: RNA World
stories.author: Philip Ball
stories.dek: A single polymer that stores the recipe and runs the kitchen — before DNA, before proteins.

stories.title: Lipids First
stories.author: Perri Thaler
stories.dek: A single polymer that stores the recipe and runs the kitchen — before DNA, before proteins.

stories.title: Metabolism
stories.author: Jake Buehler
stories.dek: A single polymer that stores the recipe and runs the kitchen — before DNA, before proteins.

chase.title: The Chase for Life’s Origins
chase.author: Yasemin Saplakoglu
chase.dek: Each of the three stories is beautiful. Each may also be wrong — or only a fragment. This is the piece that knocks them down, and asks what is left standing.
